faq.a: Any public GitHub repository with at least 50 stars. Archived repos are excluded.
At the deadline, the star count is read from the GitHub API by an oracle and written on-chain. The market settles in the same block.
$FORK holders vote on featured markets and share a part of the trading fees.

hero.headline: Bet on the repos that are about to break out.
hero.subheadline: Pick any public repository, call its next star milestone and trade the outcome. Prices move with real traction: commits, releases, and the day it hits the front page.

steps.body: Search trending repos or paste a link to one you have been watching.
steps.title: Find a repo

steps.body: Buy YES if you think it hits the milestone by the deadline, NO if you don't.

closing.body: Open a market before everyone else notices it.
closing.headline: The next big repo is already trending.

features.body: Paste a GitHub link and a market opens in seconds, with milestones set from the repo's current stars and growth rate.
features.title: Any public repo

features.body: Stars, forks, contributors and release cadence stream into every market so you trade on signal, not vibes.
features.title: Live traction data

features.body: Milestones are checked against the GitHub API at the deadline and settle automatically. No disputes, no committees.
